title: Ar-Rahman
urdu: بے حد اور بے پایاں رحمت فرمانے والا (تمام مخلوقات پر)۔
english: The Most Gracious, whose mercy encompasses all creation.

steps.title: Makna Aur Rahmat Ka Ehsas
steps.detail: Zindagi, rizq aur hidayat mein Allah ki aam rehmaton par ghaur karein jo har jaandar ke liye maujood hain.

steps.title: Zikr Aur Dua
steps.detail: Rahmat-e-ilahi ki talab ke sath 'Ya Rahman' ka zikr karein aur dil ko mayusi se bachayein.

steps.title: Amal Mein Akas
steps.detail: Jab Allah ki wasi rehmat ka khayal aaye to doosron ke liye bhi asaani paida karne ki koshish karein.

title: Ar-Rahim
urdu: نہایت رحم کرنے والا (خاص طور پر مومنوں کے حال پر)۔
english: The Most Merciful, especially to the believers in their deeds and hereafter.

steps.title: Narm Dili Apnayein
steps.detail: Doosron ke sath rehmat, darguzar aur shafqat ka sulook karein aur sakhti se bachein.

steps.title: Maghfirat Ki Umeed
steps.detail: Apni kotahiyon par 'Ya Rahim' kehte hue tauba aur daimi rehmat ki dua karein.

steps.title: Ibadat Mein Lazzat
steps.detail: Namaz, tilawat aur zikar ko bojh nahi balke apne Rab ki khas rehmat ke qareeb hone ka zariya samjhein.

title: Al-Malik
urdu: حقیقی بادشاہ اور کائنات کا اصل مالک۔
english: The King and Sovereign Lord of the entire universe.

steps.title: Haqeeqi Badshahi Ka Iqrar
steps.detail: Samjhein ke duniya aur aakhirat ki asal hukumat aur ikhtiyar sirf Allah ki zaat ke paas hai.

steps.title: Tawakkul Barhayein
steps.detail: Faislon, rizq aur badalte halat mein asli Malik par bharosa rakhein aur duniyawi taqaton se na darein.

steps.title: Inksari Aur Adab
steps.detail: Jab 'Al-Malik' ka zikr karein to apne andar takabbur ke bajaye aajizi aur farmabardari paida karein.

title: Al-Quddus
urdu: ہر عیب، نقص اور کمزوری سے پاک ذات۔
english: The Most Sacred and Pure, free from every imperfection and flaw.

steps.title: Tasbeeh Aur Paaki Ka Iqrar
steps.detail: Yeh yaqeen rakhein ke Allah har insani kamzori, zulm aur aib se bilkul pak o munazzah hai.

steps.title: Zahir Aur Batin Ki Safai
steps.detail: Apne libas, jism aur mahol ke sath apne dil ko bhi hasad, riyakari aur bure khayalat se paak rakhein.

steps.title: Ruku Aur Sajde Mein Zikr
steps.detail: 'Subbuhun Quddusun Rabbul Mala'ikati war-Ruh' parh kar Allah ki paaki bayan karein.

title: As-Salam
urdu: سلامتی دینے والا اور ہر آفت و نقص سے محفوظ۔
english: The Source of Peace, Safety, and Perfection.

steps.title: Namaz Ke Baad Zikr
steps.detail: Har farz namaz ke baad 'Allahumma Antas-Salam wa minkas-Salam' parh kar salamti ki dua karein.

steps.title: Aman Aur Salamti Phailayein
steps.detail: Apni zaban aur hath se doosron ko mehfooz rakhein aur mulazmat, ghar aur muashre mein aman ka sabab banein.

steps.title: Pareshani Mein Sukoon
steps.detail: Khauf ya bechaini ke waqt 'Ya Salam' ke zariye Allah se dili itminan aur hifazat maangein.

title: Al-Mu'min
urdu: امن و امان عطا کرنے والا اور اپنے وعدوں کی تصدیق فرمانے والا۔
english: The Giver of Security and Faith, who grants peace and affirms His truth.

steps.title: Hifazat Ka Yaqeen
steps.detail: Samjhein ke asal aman aur khauf se nijat sirf Allah ki panah mein aane se milti hai.

steps.title: Qabil-e-Etimad Banein
steps.detail: Apne wadon aur amanaton ko poora karein taake log aap se khauf nahi balke bharosa mehsoos karein.

steps.title: Eeman Ki Mazbooti
steps.detail: Allah se eeman ki salamti aur yaqeen-e-kamil ki dua karte rahein.

title: Al-Muhaymin
urdu: ہر چیز کا نگہبان، محافظ اور پوری طرح نگرانی کرنے والا۔
english: The Guardian, Overseer, and Protector of all things.

steps.title: Muraqaba Aur Nigrani Ka Ehsas
steps.detail: Tanhaai aur mehfil dono mein yaad rakhein ke Allah hamare har amal aur niyyat ko dekh raha hai.

steps.title: Apnon Ko Allah Ki Hifazat Mein Dein
steps.detail: Ghar se nikalte waqt ya apnon ke liye fikarmand hon to unhein Al-Muhaymin ki hifazat ke supurd karein.

steps.title: Zimmedari Nibhayein
steps.detail: Jo log ya kaam aap ke supurd hain un ki imandari aur khair-khwahi ke sath dekh-bhal karein.

title: Al-Aziz
urdu: سب پر غالب، زبردست عزت اور قوت والا جسے کوئی مغلوب نہیں کر سکتا۔
english: The Almighty, Invincible, and All-Powerful, whom none can overcome.

steps.title: Izzat Sirf Allah Se Maangein
steps.detail: Samjhein ke asal izzat daulat ya ohde se nahi balke Allah ki itaat aur us ke ataa karne se milti hai.

steps.title: Mushkil Waqt Mein Himmat
steps.detail: Jab halat kamzor kar dein to 'Ya Aziz' ko yaad kar ke Allah ki ghalib taqat par bharosa rakhein.

steps.title: Nafs Ki Ghulami Se Azaadi
steps.detail: Gunaah aur zillat ke kaamon se bach kar apne eeman ki izzat aur waqar ko barqarar rakhein.

title: Al-Jabbar
urdu: اپنا حکم نافذ کرنے والا اور ٹوٹے ہوئے دلوں اور بگڑے کاموں کو سنوارنے والا۔
english: The Compeller whose will prevails, and the Restorer who mends the broken.

steps.title: Toote Dil Ki Marham
steps.detail: Jab dil dukhi ho ya nuqsan ho jaye to 'Al-Jabbar' se dua karein ke Woh aap ke halat aur dil ko jor de.

steps.title: Zulm Se Bachna
steps.detail: Apni taqat ya ikhtiyar ka ghalat istemal kar ke kisi kamzor par zabardasti ya zulm na karein.

steps.title: Raza-e-Ilahi Ke Aage Jhukna
steps.detail: Allah ke faislon aur ahkam ke samne khushi se sar tasleem kham karein.

title: Al-Mutakabbir
urdu: کبریائی اور بڑائی کا حقیقی مستحق، ہر مخلوق سے بلند و بالا۔
english: The Supreme in Greatness and Majesty, to whom alone all pride and greatness belong.

steps.title: Takabbur Se Mukammal Parhez
steps.detail: Samjhein ke barai sirf Allah ki sifat hai; insan ke liye takabbur karna sakht pasandida nahi.

steps.title: Aajizi Ikhtiyar Karein
steps.detail: Ilm, maal ya khandan par gharoor karne ke bajaye har insan ke sath tawazo aur izzat se pesh aayein.

steps.title: Takbeer Ki Rooh
steps.detail: Namaz mein 'Allahu Akbar' kehte waqt dil se iqrar karein ke Allah har cheez se bada hai.

title: Al-Khaliq
urdu: عدم سے وجود میں لانے والا اور ہر چیز کو اندازے کے مطابق پیدا کرنے والا۔
english: The Creator who brings everything into existence from nothing with perfect measure.

steps.title: Kainat Mein Ghaur O Fikr
steps.detail: Aasman, zameen, mausam aur apni takhleeq par ghaur kar ke Al-Khaliq ki qudrat ko pehchanein.

steps.title: Makhlooq Se Muhabbat
steps.detail: Allah ki paida ki hui tamam makhlooqat—insanon, janwaron aur qudrat—ke sath reham aur hifazat ka sulook karein.

steps.title: Maqsad-e-Takhleeq Yaad Rakhein
steps.detail: Khud ko yaad dilayein ke hamein Allah ne apni ibadat aur zameen par bhalai phailane ke liye paida kiya hai.

title: Al-Bari
urdu: بے مثال اور بے عیب صورت میں پیدا کرنے والا۔
english: The Originator and Maker who creates everything in harmony without flaw or prior model.

steps.title: Apni Sakht Par Shukar
steps.detail: Apne jism, aql aur salahiyaton par Al-Bari ka shukar ada karein aur unhein naik kaamon mein lagayein.

steps.title: Kisi Ki Shakl Ya Khilqat Par Tanqeed Na Karein
steps.detail: Kisi ki zahiri shakl, rang ya kamzori ka mazaq na udayein kyunkay har takhleeq Al-Bari ki hikmat se hai.

steps.title: Tawazun Aur Safai
steps.detail: Apne kaam aur zindagi mein saleeqa, tawazun aur khoobsurti paida karne ki koshish karein.

title: Al-Musawwir
urdu: ہر مخلوق کو جداگانہ شکل و صورت عطا فرمانے والا۔
english: The Fashioner and Bestower of Forms, giving every creation its unique shape and features.

steps.title: Aaina Dekhte Waqt Dua
steps.detail: Aaina dekhte waqt dua karein: 'Allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fa hassin khuluqi' (Jaise meri surat achhi banai, mera akhlaq bhi achha bana de).

steps.title: Seerat Ki Khoobsurti
steps.detail: Sirf zahiri libas par nahi balke sachai, sabr aur khush-akhlaqi se apni seerat ko bhi khoobsurat banayein.

steps.title: Qudrat Ke Rangon Ki Qadr
steps.detail: Har insan aur makhlooq ke alag rang o roop ko Allah ki nishani samajh kar ehtiram dein.

title: Al-Ghaffar
urdu: بار بار گناہوں کو بخشنے والا اور عیبوں پر پردہ ڈالنے والا۔
english: The Perpetual Forgiver, who repeatedly forgives sins and conceals faults.

steps.title: Tauba Mein Der Na Karein
steps.detail: Gunaah ho jaye to mayus hone ke bajaye foran 'Ya Ghaffar' kehte hue sachi tauba karein.

steps.title: Doosron Ke Aib Chhupayein
steps.detail: Jab Allah hamare aib chhupata hai to hamein bhi doosron ki ghaltiyon ko uchhalne ke bajaye parda rakhna chahiye.

steps.title: Kasrat-e-Istighfar
steps.detail: Chalte phirte 'Astaghfirullah' parhne ki aadat dalen taake dil halka rahe aur barkat aaye.

title: Al-Qahhar
urdu: سب کو اپنے قبضۂ قدرت میں رکھنے والا اور ہر سرکش پر غالب۔
english: The Subduer and Dominant, who holds absolute control over all creation.

steps.title: Khauf-e-Khuda Aur Nafs Par Qabu
steps.detail: Apne nafs ki buri khwahishat aur ghusse par qabu pane ke liye Al-Qahhar se madad maangein.

steps.title: Zalim Se Na Darein
steps.detail: Yaad rakhein ke har zalim aur firaun ke upar Allah ki qahhariyat maujood hai, is liye haq par qaim rahein.

steps.title: Dunya Ki Mohabbat Ko Had Mein Rakhein
steps.detail: Dil ko sirf fani cheezon ka ghulam na banayein balke asli malik o hakim ke samne jhukayein.
